title: Oil Rises on Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia and Hormuz Disruption
summary: Gotrade News - Oil prices rose on Wednesday, October 7, with Brent crude climbing above $101 per barrel and extending gains from the previous session.
body_markdown:
The same report noted crude inventories fell by 2.1 million barrels in the previous week, with official US data due later on Wednesday.

## What Brent Above $100 Means for US Energy Stocks


For US-listed energy names such as[Exxon Mobil (XOM)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/xom/) ,[Chevron (CVX)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cvx/) and[Occidental Petroleum (OXY)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/oxy/) , Brent holding above $100 keeps crude prices at the center of the story.


The tug of war between attacks on Gulf energy routes and recovering export volumes is what traders will be weighing as the official US inventory data lands.
